title: Example library data file
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y9 lesson 14 (Example library data file (portal))
intro: Lesson 14: Validation and lookup. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

keywords.def: a check that data is sensible and allowed
a value must be between limits
a function that finds a value in a table

questions.q: Write a validation rule for 'pages' in the library table.
In the library spreadsheet: add two validation rules and one lookup that returns a book title from its ID; test with good and bad data.
questions.a: Working rules and lookup, with tests recorded.

questions.q: Extend: add a drop-down list for 'Available' (Yes/No).
Stretch: explain why validation cannot prove data is correct.
questions.a: Plausible but wrong values still pass.
A) Age must be between 11 and 18. Range: between limits.

questions.q: Think again: Validation stops someone typing an age of 250. Can it stop someone typing the wrong (but possible) age?
questions.a: No: 14 instead of 15 passes validation. Verification (double-checking) is also needed.
